svg.title: Hình 3-4: Sơ đồ lớp (Class Diagram) 3 tầng — SmartMacro Engine
svg.text: SƠ ĐỒ LỚP KIẾN TRÚC 3 TẦNG (THREE-TIER CLASS DIAGRAM) — SMARTMACRO ENGINE
Tuân thủ nguyên lý Dependency Inversion: Controller → Service Interface/Impl → Optimization Engine (OR-Tools) → EF Core DbContext
TẦNG 1: PRESENTATION / API CONTROLLERS (ASP.NET Core Web API 8.0 - RESTful endpoints)
TẦNG 2: BUSINESS LOGIC / SERVICE ABSTRACTION & IMPLEMENTATION (DTO Mapping & Business Rules)
TẦNG 3A: ALGORITHMIC OPTIMIZATION ENGINE (Google OR-Tools GLOP Linear Solver)
TẦNG 3B: DATA ACCESS LAYER (Entity Framework Core 8.0 & SQL Server Persistence)

g.text: - AddMacroConstraint(solver, grams, inv, selector, target, name)
